content.text: Fabre describes Osmiae nesting in his study, tubes, reeds, shells, and old bee nests, showing that mothers regulate offspring sex according to cell size and can produce male-only groups. He then examines Glow-worms in jars, which anesthetize and liquefy snails, and Cabbage-caterpillars in gardens and cages, including their parasitic Microgaster. A history recounts the Lower Canadian rebellions at St Denis, St Charles, Moore’s Corners, St Eustache, Napierville, Lacolle, Odelltown, and Beauharnois, followed by Durham’s arrival in Quebec and departure for Britain. Dante’s final Inferno cantos descend through Cocytus and leave Hell. A comedy unfolds in Coddle’s house. In an adventure narrative, Ben’s group travels from Quito to a mountain camp and haunted temple; Sam, Jimmie, and Carl investigate Peru, encounter staged ghosts, thieves, savages, and an abandoned aeroplane.
